t: Definition of Full Buy | PokerZone
s: A buy-in that meets or exceeds the required minimum buy-in for a particular game; as opposed to a short buy · EXAMPLE: "The minimum buy-in was $100. I bought in to the game for $175, and made another full buy when I lost that. I lost the whole $275 before deciding to switch tables."
